svg.title: What the bots do on their own
svg.desc: Every night, the end-to-end tests run against every supported Nextcloud, as its images move with each point release. Every morning, the findings bot keeps every alert of code scanning fixed or accepted, and the issue lifecycle sends its reminders and closes what is due. Every week, the upstream bot and the blueprint bot open pull requests for a new Nextcloud and a new blueprint, the canary tests the coming Nextcloud, and the contract tests check the app against a real Paperless-ngx 2.x and 3.x; the link check, the mutation tests, the OpenSSF Scorecard, the release verification, CodeQL, OSV-Scanner, the secret scan of the whole history, the SBOM and zizmor check the repository; the clean-up bot and the settings bot tidy it up. All of it ends in a pull request that merges itself, an issue that closes itself once fixed, or a report. The bots are blue, and what comes out green.
